signals.title: EICMA 2026> Honda Announces Honda SENSING RIDE Advanced Rider Assistance System for Motorcycles – Debuting on the CRF1150L Africa Twin Adventure Sports
signals.summary: MILAN, Italy, November 3, 2026 - Honda today presented the world premiere of the 27YM CRF1150L Africa Twin large-size adventure bike series at EICMA 2026 (Milan Motorcycle Show; Press days: November 3-4, Public days: November 5-8) in Milan, Italy. The 27YM CRF1150L Africa Twin Series, a full model change of the Africa Twin Series, was developed with the concept of “Shaped by You. True Adventure for All.” Building on the previous generation CRF1100L Africa Twin, the all-new CRF1150L Africa Twin Series models deliver enhanced riding performance through increased engine displacement, while further elevating ease of handling and overall balance as an adventure bike through extensive weight reduction throughout the motorcycle and the adoption of a low-center-of-gravity layout. The CRF1150L Africa Twin Series comprises three variants: the existing Africa Twin and Africa Twin Adventure Sports, as well as the newly added Africa Twin Enduro Sports, which features increased off-road performance. The CRF1150L Africa Twin Adventure Sports will be the first Honda motorcycle equipped with Honda SENSING RIDE, a newly developed advanced safety and rider-assistance system. Each of the three Africa Twin models offers distinct value, and the Africa Twin Series now accommodates a wider range of riding styles. The CRF1150L Africa Twin is the standard model offering an excellent balance of off-road performance and touring performance at a high level. Compared with the previous generation model, the platform and engine have been updated, and the HMI (Human Machine Interface) has been renewed. The model also features advanced equipment, including an electrically adjustable windscreen, Showa Electronically Equipped Ride Adjustment (Showa EERA™) which now incorporates Honda Skyhook technology and a Honda Smart Key system. The CRF1150L Africa Twin Adventure Sports is designed in pursuit of enhanced convenience and comfort on long-distance touring, featuring a large 24-liter fuel tank and a 19-inch front wheel. The model also offers the option of Honda SENSING RIDE advanced safety and rider-assistive system that enhances safety, the rider’s peace of mind and comfort. The newly added CRF1150L Africa Twin Enduro Sports is designed to deliver genuine off-road performance while catering to a wide range of rider needs, a hallmark of the Africa Twin Series models. The model features a front suspension and exclusive styling derived from the CRF450 RALLY, which competes in the Dakar Rally, delivering enhanced off-road capability and greater joy of riding. With these three models, the CRF1150L Africa Twin Series now offers a lineup that accommodates the needs of a wide range of riders, from those who prioritize off-road riding to touring enthusiasts who mainly ride on paved roads, as well as riders seeking the latest technology and long-distance riding capability. The liquid-cooled 1,131cc, parallel twin-cylinder engine for the all-new CRF1150L Africa Twin Series models delivers maximum power of 87.5kW @7,500prm and maximum torque of 119Nm @5,700rpm. Greater acceleration performance and comfortable cruising are realized through an increase in engine displacement, compression ratio and bore diameter as well as an optimization of the intake/exhaust system and a revision of gear ratios. The newly designed frame body and swingarm, with a revised rigidity balance, are 1.4kg lighter compared with the previous generation models, delivering a supple and agile ride feel. While retaining the distinctive styling of Africa Twin, CF1150L Africa Twin Series models feature a fuel sub-tank positioned beneath the seat, realizing a lower center of gravity. This improves maneuverability and control at low speeds. The CRF1150L Africa Twin Enduro Sports features a front suspension with specifications equivalent to that of the CRF450 RALLY, enabling excellent off-road riding performance. The CRF1150L Africa Twin and CRF1150L Africa Twin Adventure Sports feature the SHOWA Electronically Equipped Ride Adjustment (SHOWA EERA™) electronically controlled suspension (manufactured by Astemo, Ltd.) with Honda Skyhook control. The system detects the vehicle behavior in real time and continuously optimizes damping force to help the motorcycle settle more quickly. This suppresses unwanted movements of the motorcycle and realizes a high quality, comfortable riding experience that the rider can enjoy with greater confidence. A new product emblem, “Honda Flagship WING,” featuring a monotone silver-and-black design, is also featured on both sides of the main fuel tank. Six default riding modes are available to suit different riding conditions. By integrating control of various functions, including engine output characteristics, traction control, ABS, DCT, and electronically controlled suspension, the system delivers high levels of riding performance and comfort across a wide range of riding conditions, from on-road to off-road. The CRF1150L Africa Twin Adventure Sports will be the first Honda motorcycle model to feature Honda SENSING RIDE advanced safety and rider-assistive system. Using a millimeter-wave radar unit mounted at each end of the motorcycle, Honda SENSING RIDE accurately detects the surroundings of the motorcycle. Based on its comprehensive assessment of the status of the rider and the motorcycle, the system provides notifications, warnings and operational assistance to support safe and comfortable riding. This includes collision avoidance *2 , so that the rider can enjoy riding with peace of mind. Honda SENSING RIDE riding support functions include: 1) Adaptive Cruise Control (ACC), 2) ACC with Stop & Go function, 3) Group Ride Assist and 4) Distance Assist that adjusts following distance. The system also supports the rider’s safe riding with 1) Forward Collision Warning and 2) Emergency Brake Assist. Moreover, the system also offers 1) Blind Spot Information, which offers intuitive alerts to the rider when another vehicle enters the ride

signals.summary: 万众瞩目的第 83 届米兰 EICMA 国际摩托车车展正式拉开帷幕。作为全球两轮行业的展示舞台，EICMA 汇聚了世界各地顶尖摩托品牌，不仅是展示自家摩托车技术、新车型的竞技场，也是中国摩托车品牌走向世界、展示自研实力的场地。 宗申赛科龙作为中国摩企出海的核心力量，以最新研发车型，带着面向全球市场打磨的产品方案亮相，展示中国大排制造与研发的硬实力。本次参展阵容十分丰富，品类布局全面，覆盖：中大排休旅、中排巡航、全新探险 ADV、城市潮流燃油车，同时带来新能源两轮产品，亮相车型包括 AQS628、RT450、RX628、宗申乐米、森蓝 EC1/EX1 多款主力车型。 AQS628主打复古格调与现代机械、智能安全的完美融合。外观采用经典复古圆灯巡航造型，线条温润优雅，自带松弛从容的长途骑行气质，契合国内外巡航玩家的审美偏好。 动力核心搭载578cc V型双缸水冷发动机，配备双平衡轴结构，最大限度抑制V缸发动机固有震动，长时间巡航骑行舒适感拉满。整机最大功率45kW，峰值扭矩61N·m，低扭输出充沛，无需拉高转速即可实现平稳匀速巡航，适配国道、高速长途骑行场景。 这辆车最大的核心亮点是双版本的布局，可以兼顾不同骑行人群的需求。其中AMT版本搭载MSC车身稳定控制系统，可实时感知车身姿态、倾角、加减速状态，动态优化动力输出与制动逻辑，大幅降低大排量巡航车的上手难度，新手也能轻松驾驭；而MT版本保留纯粹机械操控乐趣。 车身采用了专为长途骑行优化的人机工程三角，还有18L超大油箱可以带来很不错的续航，解决长途摩旅频繁加油的痛点；宽裕的座桶储物空间、规整的车身布局、稳定的高速行驶质感，兼顾日常城市通勤、周末山路跑山、跨省长途摩旅多重场景。 无论是产品做工、动力调校，还是细节配置，RT450都代表了国产中大排踏板的第一梯队实力，也是本次出海最具竞争力的量产车型。 是赛科龙全新打造的全能探险拉力车型，定位长途穿越、全域休旅，主打“铺装路面舒适巡航、非铺装路面从容探索”的均衡实力，针对性解决了传统ADV要么偏公路、要么偏硬核越野的两极分化痛点。 动力搭载581cc直列双缸水冷发动机，采用270°曲轴设计，模拟出V缸引擎浑厚饱满的声浪，同时保留双缸机的平顺稳定性，最大功率48kW，最大扭矩58N·m，动力调校偏向中低转速，在山路爬坡、砂石土路脱困的时候能给到充沛动力，无需频繁换挡拉扯转速。 底盘硬件采用专业越野配置，搭载KYB全可调前后倒置减震+后多连杆中置减震，搭配转向阻尼器、日信双浮动碟盘制动，高速稳定、弯道支撑扎实、烂路滤震到位。 整车提供标准/OFFROAD/OFFROAD+三档骑行模式，可根据路况一键切换电控逻辑，搭配双通道ABS、TCS、毫米波雷达盲区监测、ESS紧急制动爆闪，主动安全配置拉满。 其他配置方面有7英寸全彩TFT仪表集成1080P行车记录仪、蓝牙车机互联，18L油箱续航可达450km，真空辐条轮搭配倍耐力全地形轮胎，另外原厂自带了加热手把、加热坐垫、铝合金三箱，可以说到手即跑，不需要再改装，是一台真正适配全场景的国产全能ADV。 如果说中大排车型代表赛科龙的硬核技术实力，那宗申乐米就是品牌年轻化、国际化审美表达的核心载体。虽然同为小排量，但完全区别于传统通勤车的工具化设计，乐米主打潮流轻量化风格，造型简约灵动、线条干净利落，没有冗余的浮夸设计，精准契合年轻用户城市出行、穿搭潮玩的需求。 适配街巷穿行、短途出游、日常代步场景，车身灵活轻巧、操控随心，上手门槛极低，城市轻玩乐通勤的车型定位，再国内市场已经收获很多年轻车友的喜爱。它依托宗申成熟的小排量动力调校技术，整车起步平顺、怠速稳定、油耗经济，实用性与可玩性兼顾得十分不错。 在欧洲年轻化、轻量化城市车型盛行的市场环境下，宗申乐米凭借独有的东方设计审美，完全有实力打破海外车型的审美垄断，向全球年轻人展示中国品牌的潮流设计力量。 面对全球电动化出行趋势，宗申旗下森蓝品牌也携EC1、EX1两款新能源车型登陆米兰，完善品牌燃油+电动双线战略布局。两款车型针对性适配欧洲城市窄路、短途通勤的出行场景，主打轻便、安静、高效、安全。 整车架构专为城市代步优化，车身小巧灵活，穿梭城市拥堵路段毫无压力；电动动力输出平顺线性，零怠速噪音、零尾气排放，契合全球绿色出行理念。同时搭载成熟的电池管理系统、稳定的电控逻辑，兼顾续航表现与充电便捷性，在安全配置、人机体验、做工质感上，完全对标国际同级新能源车型，标志着宗申赛科龙在新能源两轮赛道，已具备成熟的全球化产品输出能力。 从AQS628巡航、RX628探险ADV、RT450旗舰踏板，到宗申乐米潮流燃油、森蓝新能源车型，本次米兰参展的五款产品，每一台都有着精准的市场定位、扎实的硬件支撑和清晰的用户场景。 不同于行业多数品牌单纯依靠展会曝光博热度的打法，宗申赛科龙坚持以用户真实骑行需求为核心，用技术落地解决骑行痛点、用产品分层覆盖全域市场。此次登陆米兰EICMA，不仅是国产机车实力的一次集中亮相，更是中国两轮工业从“产品出海”迈向“技术出海、理念出海”的重要突破。

signals.summary: 今年的第 83 届 EICMA，在米兰 Fiera Milano Rho 展馆 11 号馆 O06 展位，SWM以Smart Evolution・Boundless Adventure（智进・无界）为主题铺开展台。这一次带来的不再是单一车型的亮相，而是整套覆盖通勤、巡航、探险、越野四大场景的完整产品矩阵齐齐登场，就连前不久在重庆摩博会完成国内首发的智能电摩品牌缤森 BINSEN，也跟着一起出海，迎来自己的国际首秀。吸引了不少国外媒体与摩友的目光，很多骑士都听过 SWM 这个名字，它的故事，早在 1971 年就写在了米兰的越野赛道上。 Pietro Sironi与Fausto Vegani 在米兰创立 SWM 时，恰逢欧洲越野摩托的黄金时代。Enduro、场地越野、障碍攀爬赛场里，都能看见它的身影。凭借 Six Days 越野车在国际赛事持续拿下好成绩，SWM 和 KTM、Husqvarna 一同被称作欧洲三大越野品牌。在泥泞林道的一次次冲刺里，热爱、挑战、自由，慢慢沉淀成品牌刻在骨子里的精神。时间来到 2014 年，鑫源完成对 SWM 的全资收购，这个老牌意大利越野品牌翻开新的一页。它承接了原 BMW-Husqvarna 米兰生产基地的制造积淀与工程基因，同时在米兰保留独立的欧洲设计中心，留住一批本土顶尖设计师与工程师。意式的审美表达、赛场淬炼出来的底盘功底，再搭配严谨的德系制造标准，在这里融为一体。 “Free Your Soul，释放真我”，从来不是一句简单的 slogan。直到今天，SWM 的造型依旧由意大利设计师主导，底盘、动力调校交由本土工程团队打磨。半个多世纪的越野血脉没有中断，顺着车架、悬架、动力，流淌到两轮摩托与全地形车的每一台新车上。55 年前赛道上的那股血性，在 2026 年米兰的主场，借着更丰富的产品线，去往更广阔的道路。 展台 C 位，三台全球首发车型是全场目光的焦点，而 VENTURO T310 ADV，是其中思路最特别的一台。 它由国内热度很高的鑫源 255XT升级而来，海外版本排量升级至 300cc，搭载鑫源星光动力水平并列异步双缸发动机，180° 曲轴布局，点火均匀，声浪绵密，湿式 CVT 搭配强制风冷的方案，专门针对传统踏板长途容易热衰减的痛点做出优化。真正让人眼前一亮的，是它独有的云感悬架轮机分离架构。发动机固定在车架之上，后轮可以独立起伏跳动，配合多连杆后悬挂，细碎颠簸能够柔和过滤，遇到大坑冲击又有充足支撑。1:1 黄金前后配重、菱形钢管车架，再配上前 17 寸、后 15 寸真空辐条全地形轮组，等于把越野车的悬挂逻辑，装进了一台踏板车。不用换挡、上手轻松，却拥有挡车的操控底子。“踏板的便利，骑士车的灵魂”——城市通勤、周末跑山、郊游露营、长途摩旅一车通吃。 而喜欢美式巡航的海外车友，目光大多停留在STORMBREAKER SPECIALE身上。这台 1200cc 公升巡航，也就是国内大家熟悉的鑫源骓 1200 滑翔版。V 型双缸水冷八气门发动机，可以输出 49kW 最大功率、91N・m 峰值扭矩，国际五档配滑动离合+液压离合。经典 Bagger 风格，蝙蝠翼大风挡、双侧硬边箱，辨识度拉满的火焰涂装，720mm 座高对骑手十分友好，双通道 ABS 与 TCS 配齐，271kg 的体量，稳稳撑起 SWM 公升级巡航旗舰的定位。 探险车区域，VERSANTE 550/550S、650/650S 四款车型同台展出，它们是鑫源 525X 的海外版本，共享同一探险底盘平台。两款 550 车型搭载 494cc 并列双缸，两款 650 升级至 625cc。全系博世电喷、KYB 全可调前减震、钢丝辐条轮、19L 大容量油箱，ABS 和 TCS 支持关闭，给越野穿越留出足够空间。S 版本依靠专属配色和鸟嘴造型，进一步强化越野气质，815mm 与 830mm 两种座高，能适配不同身高的探险玩家。 还有一台 VEGA 300 欧系平踏板，源自国内 250CT，升级到 300cc 排量，风格主打通勤轻快与欧系大踏板稳重质感，作为低门槛城市代步选择，完善了踏板产品线。 除了两轮摩托，SWM Powersports （斯威动力），也带来两台重磅全地形旗舰全球首发：TRAILHUNTER 1000（猎荒者，运动全能ATV）与NOMADER 1000（游牧者，全能舒适UTV)，同步亮相的还有中排量的 TRAILHUNTER 720、NOMADER 720。两台旗舰采用全新 VASTERRA （纵横）家族设计语言，1000cc 动力平台可以输出 101 马力，搭配BOSCH燃烧控制系统与高效冷却 CVT。悬架行程较头部竞品提升大约30%，可选 CDC 连续阻尼减震，10.25 英寸TFT屏幕、T-Box车联网一应俱全。TRAILHUNTER 1000偏向运动，1:1 配重、可调气囊减震、311mm离地间隙，主打林间穿越的操控乐趣；NOMADER1000更看重舒适体验，恒温空调、快拆货箱、360° 全景影像，重新定义舒适向 UTV。品牌后续还会继续拓展混动、SSV、纯电全地形车型。 燃油之外，作为鑫源集团旗下的智能电摩品牌——缤森 BINSEN，在今年 9 月重庆摩博会完成国内首发之后，这次第一次登上米兰国际展台，六台实车悉数到场：城市踏板 C5、S5、S6，以及 X1、X2 Ultra、X5 越野电摩家族。缤森坚持以燃油摩托车的标准去调校电摩，依托森盾架构、森联智域、缤核动能、镁翼架构四项自研核心技术。S5 搭载 180°ADAS 辅助驾驶、7kW 峰值电机，主打安全通勤；C5 凭借意式复古外观搭配全域灯效，主打潮流属性；旗舰 S6 计划 2027 年上市，搭载同级少见的中置扁线电机，原厂极速可达 100km/h；X系列越野家族覆盖青少年入门到专业级全谱系。 从 1971 年米兰郊外的赛道，到 2026 年 Rho 展馆 11 号馆的 O06 展位，SWM 走过了 55 年。意大利本土的设计审美、宝马工厂的制造基因、越野赛场血性，叠加鑫源集团成熟的研发与制造实力，共同构筑了现在的 signals.title: 奔赴米兰！猎变机甲虎Nomad350，把年轻人的4+2骑行生活带向世界
signals.summary: 每年米兰车展，总能看到国产品牌不一样的新气象。今年各家也都在向世界展示我们的新车型、新技术，比拼极速、堆砌参数都是常态，其中比较不同的是猎变这个品牌。 这次猎变再度登陆米兰EICMA，不止是简单参展亮车，现场还办了品牌分享会，也带来了大家很值得关注的海外新动态：正式和意大利本土老牌机车企业PELPI达成深度合作，扎根意大利市场，持续拓宽自己的欧洲出海版图。 猎变背靠豪进集团，有着25年的造车积淀，品控和供应链一直特别稳，车型早就卖到全球三十多个国家，在欧洲多个国家也积累了不少真实用户和好口碑。这次和意大利团队联手，不只是单纯的开拓市场，后续双方还会一起交流研发、共创打磨车型，结合欧洲当地的骑行场景和审美，去优化整车细节，让我们的国产原创车型，更适配全球玩家的骑行口味。 而且这次米兰展，猎变也一次性带来了超多新车，完整亮出了自己的全品类产品矩阵，覆盖了几乎所有年轻骑行场景。不管是新手入门好骑的KAIROS 125街车、KAIROS-R 125仿赛，主打户外探索的NEXOR 250，能通勤也能玩轻越野的FLYGON 125/220，甚至还有给青少年打造的电动小车，品类特别全，也能真切看出品牌深耕年轻骑行市场的诚意。 而整场展会里，最亮眼、最贴合当下年轻人骑行喜好，也是本次出海核心代表的车型，绝对是这台机甲虎Nomad350。这款车型在今年的中国摩博会也进行了展出，小编当时也到现场对其研究了一番，也和研发人员进行了交流。猎变这台Nomad350比较独特的是，它不想做一台只会代步的工具车，也不做一台只为竞速的机器，它真正想打造的，是无数年轻人向往的4+2松弛玩乐生活。 机甲虎传递的骑行逻辑特别简单、也特别治愈：四轮带你去该去的地方，两轮带你去想去的地方。它适配的从来不是奔波式摩旅，也不止速度和里程，更多的是自由和治愈，所有随性的瞬间。不用被节奏束缚，骑着爱车奔赴自己向往的山野与浪漫。不用刻意规划路线，去郊外溪边坐坐、去山顶追一场日落、去山野露营放空。不用被路线定义，带着松弛自在的4+2生活方式走向世界，这就是猎变的初心，也是当代年轻人最纯粹的骑行热爱。 作为一台350cc级别的跨界玩乐踏板，机甲虎的每一处设计，确实也都是从日常玩乐、真实出行的角度出发，颜值、个性、实用、安全都兼顾到了。 我最心动的，就是它同级独有的车头DIY自定义屏幕。市面上绝大多数车子的屏幕、车标都是固定死的，千车一面。而这台Nomad350，可以自己随意编辑文字、涂鸦、图案。你的心情、你的态度，都能通过车头屏幕展现出来。 它更像一个专属你的“机械宠物”，而不是冰冷的交通工具。可以玩个性、玩穿搭、玩专属感，彻底摆脱撞款尴尬，把年轻人的小众态度拿捏得死死的。 颜值和质感方面，也长在年轻人审美上。独特的钛金属拼接材质，搭配硬朗利落的机甲线条，自带满满的硬派气场。最加分的是原厂一体化护杠设计，不是后期改装的突兀样式，它是在研发阶段就计划的内容，所以完全不会影响操控，并且和整车造型完美融合，颜值在线的同时实用性拉满。 平时进山穿梭、市区代步，偶尔轻微剐蹭完全不用心疼，放开胆子随心玩，不用小心翼翼护着车子，完美适配松弛的玩乐骑行状态。 安全层面整车标配ABS+TCS，再加上高亮双透镜大灯和全车LED光源和其他实用性的配置，将骑行的个性化和实用性都兼顾到位了。 关注踏板圈子的朋友应该都有感触，现在的踏板车基本分成了两个极端。要么就是纯粹的代步工具，造型虽然相比前几年已然好看很多，但还是千篇一律，通勤代步为主，玩乐性较低；要么就是一味追求高性能、高极速，高配置，把骑行变成了紧绷的赶路和攀比，少了一份踏板该有的松弛感。 在这个跟风模仿、盲目内卷的行业环境里，猎变的坚持其实很难得。一直踏踏实实做原创设计，不跟风堆配置、不盲目拼速度，只专注做年轻人真正喜欢、能用得上、有温度的车型。从深耕国内年轻市场，到三次站上米兰国际舞台、稳步开拓海外版图，靠的从来不是噱头，而是实打实的造车用心。 所以在我看来，Nomad350这次出海，意义不只是一台新车亮相国际舞台。它代表着国产机车的另一种可能性：我们不再只会做工具车、做竞速车，我们也能做出有态度、有情绪、有生活感的车型。

signals.title: 标致PULSION211丨长久陪伴，贴心守护每一位用户
signals.summary: 自发售以来，车友圈对它的评价声音也有所不同，其中传动皮带问题，是大家讨论最多、也最关心的一点。免费升级的点在哪里？厂家又是怎么给出解决方案的？ 先聊聊踏板车的皮带传动逻辑。绝大多数踏板都采用皮带二级传动，对比链条，它的传动效率会有一定损耗，但胜在运行安静、震动更小，日常不用频繁打理保养，非常契合踏板车省心代步的定位，但它同样存在短板：不像链条那样适应性强，皮带的使用寿命，会受停放时间、用车环境、驾驶习惯影响。长期静置会自然老化，温差变化加上激烈驾驶，都会加剧皮带负荷，理论上每一台车皮带的寿命都会有差异，正常情况下差距不会太大。 落到 PULSION211 这台车上，问题的核心根源在于传动散热。早期版本 CVT 传动箱依靠进气风冷散热，搭配纸质传动滤芯，很容易发生堵塞。一旦滤芯堵死，传动箱就像一个密闭焖罐，箱内热量无法及时散出，持续高温会加速橡胶皮带老化、打滑，严重时还会出现掉齿的情况。而不少车主日常保养很容易忽略传动系统，到店保养大多只更换机油，很少主动更换传动滤芯，多重因素叠加，就催生了一系列皮带相关故障。 好在标致摩托对这个问题足够重视，发现问题之后没有推卸甩锅，第一时间复盘分析原因并推出整改方案。标致摩托推出“周年感恩 金秋升级”服务，自2026 年 8 月 1 日之前出厂的车辆，全部可以享受免费升级服务，更换“日本三之星皮带”，同时把原来的纸质滤芯升级成通透性更好的“增强海绵滤芯”，配套还有包含 20 个项目的全车深度点检。8 月 1 日后下线的新车，出厂就直接搭载这套升级件。官方直面问题、主动兜底，目的就是让车主骑得安心、用得放心。标致摩托不做一锤子买卖，愿意为用户的骑行体验买单，售后的底气，也是品牌诚意最好的体现。 这份选择，不只是对标致售后态度的信赖，更是发自内心喜欢这台车本身。辨识度拉满的狮魂家族外观，参考标致勒芒超跑 9X8 的设计语言，把复古格调与运动气质融合得恰到好处，外观凶萌、内在动力底子同样不俗。 我个人最喜欢的一个点，就是这套车规级三联 TFT 仪表，氛围感直接拉满，骑行过程中车速、转速、水温、导航等信息一目了然，信息读取轻松不分散注意力，能看出它在设计细节上花了不少心思。 如果说法系设计独一份，那它的底盘调校同样是亮点。作为一台 GT 取向运动踏板，动力调校相对普通踏板更为优秀，油门虚位很小，动力输出干脆不拖沓。车架采用高强度无缝钢管结构，搭配标致标志性的底盘动平衡调校，正置前减震配合后双枪减震，运动玩乐与日常骑行。城市里碾过井盖、减速带，震动过滤柔和；高速巡航或者压弯的时候，减震支撑性在线，车身稳定性很强，不会出现发飘的情况。配合标配的 ABS 与 TCS，不管是城市通勤代步，还是短途跑山，都能给到充足的信心。 总的来说，标致摩托在面对车辆问题时，始终坚持用户至上，不逃避、不推卸，主动沟通、落实整改，给车主稳定可靠的后勤保障。而众多车主愿意选择 PULSION211，不单是认可厂家处理问题的态度，更因为这台车本身，拥有独树一帜的外观设计、成熟的动力底盘调校以及丰富的智能配置，在同级别踏板里走出了属于自己的法式 GT 路线。

signals.title: The new Yamaha RW series scooter, beyond the city
signals.summary: Yamaha breaks new ground at EICMA 2026 by officially launching the RW Series and pioneering the brand-new Adventure Scooter segment. Unveiled to the world, the three new models—the RW700, RW700 Explore, and RW350 —bridge the gap between everyday urban commuting and rugged off-road exploration. Sharing long-travel suspension, aggressive off-road tread patterns, and a striking aesthetic inspired by the legendary Ténéré 700 family , these machines are built for riders who refuse to let the pavement define their journey. At the heart of the new flagship RW700 beats the acclaimed 690cc CP2 twin-cylinder engine, churning out 69.3 horsepower and 65 Nm of torque. This powerhouse is paired with an advanced Y-AMT automated manual transmission, specially tuned for both city streets and dirt trails. Throttle management is handled by the YCC-T electronic ride-by-wire system, while the comprehensive electronics suite features a 6-axis IMU and the YRC system, offering dedicated Road and Gravel modes tailored for off-road control. The rider aids are rounded out by Traction Control (TCS), Slide Control (SCS), and Brake Control (BCS/BSR). When the road gets rough, the suspension steps up with a 41mm front fork offering 160mm of travel, complemented by a rear monoshock featuring 155mm of travel with adjustable preload and rebound. Stopping power is managed by a braking system equipped with a switchable rear ABS for loose dirt surfaces. Spoked wheels measuring 17 inches up front and 15 inches in the rear keep the adventure rolling. Up front, a 5-inch TFT display connects to your smartphone via the MyRide app, delivering seamless navigation through the free Garmin StreetCross app, alongside a convenient USB-C charging port. The new Yamaha RW700 will hit showrooms in striking Sage Blue and Power Grey. Taking things a step further, the RW700 Explore retains the robust DNA of the standard model while adding premium touring features: a fully adjustable front fork, heated grips and a heated seat with ten selectable levels, a sturdy center stand, and backlit handlebar switchgear. This ultimate adventure-ready trim will arrive in exclusive Forest Green and Midnight Black colorways. Rounding out the lineup is the agile RW350 , powered by an all-new 330cc liquid-cooled, 4-valve single-cylinder engine producing 29.2 horsepower at 7,000 rpm and 31.5 Nm of torque at 5,750 rpm. It introduces Yamaha’s innovative Dynamic Ride architecture, featuring a frame-mounted engine design where the CVT pivots around the crankshaft axis. Despite its smaller displacement, it packs a serious technological punch with a 6-axis IMU, YCC-T, YRC modes for street and dirt, and traction control. It rides on a 37mm front fork with 140mm of travel and dual rear shock absorbers offering 105mm of travel with adjustable preload, rolling on 16-inch front and 14-inch rear wheels. Premium touches like a 5-inch TFT screen, USB-C port, Smart Key system, and Cruise Control complete the package. The new Yamaha RW350 will be available in Sage Blue, Arashi Sand, and Midnight Black. signals.title: BMW M 1000 RS: available worldwide from March, limited to 1,000 units
signals.summary: The BMW M 1000 RS makes its debut at EICMA, with the Munich-based manufacturer describing it as "the world's most powerful hyper naked bike". At its heart is the 999 cc inline-four engine inherited from the M 1000 RR, producing 218 hp (160 kW) and 113 Nm of torque. With a kerb weight of 196 kg, the power-to-weight ratio exceeds 1.1 hp/kg. Claimed performance figures include a 0–100 km/h time of 3.2 seconds and a top speed of 283 km/h. The M 1000 RS is based on the M 1000 R with the M Competition Package , but features further upgrades. Equipment includes the M footrests from the RR and a seat raised by 20 mm to 850 mm above the ground. Other highlights include the full titanium M exhaust system, matt carbon M winglets and the tail section from the M 1000 RR. The package is completed by a brushed aluminium fuel tank, new graphics and an M seat with an Alcantara-style finish. The bike features 17-inch M Carbon wheels fitted with 120/70 ZR17 front and 200/55 ZR17 rear tyres. The suspension is electronically controlled by the DDC system. The M braking system comprises twin 320 mm discs with four-piston radial calipers, ABS Pro and DTC. Equipment includes Riding Modes Pro , Gearshift Assistant Pro, the M short-stroke throttle, cruise control, heated grips, Keyless Ride, M brake and clutch levers, and the M Track Package. The M 1000 RS will go on sale in March 2027, in a limited production run of 1,000 units worldwide. signals.title: Ariete introduces the very first grip of the FIXT line
signals.summary: Ariete proudly introduces the very first grip of the FIXT line —fully designed, engineered, and manufactured at our historic headquarters based in Varese. Because details make all the difference, precision laser-etching technology ensures an ergonomic, secure hold, delivering optimal grip and absolute control on every ride. The FIXT line features an exclusive, hypoallergenic medium-compound formula developed entirely by Ariete, built for an exceptional, long-lasting feel. Equipped with a user-friendly lock-on system for effortless installation and removal, these grips come in 6 striking colors and include 6 interchangeable cams to fit a wide range of popular 2-stroke and 4-stroke motorcycles. Safety is paramount: the clutch side features a dedicated mechanical lock that prevents both rotation and lateral movement. By securing the lock-on to the throttle tube with specialized interlocking tabs, the over-molded grip and the lock-on become a single, unified piece, drastically improving pull-off resistance. The aluminum clamp also undergoes an advanced ETD treatment borrowed directly from the automotive industry. On the throttle side, interchangeable octagonal-coupling cams allow you to precisely dial in your grip position. Riders can choose from 8 different 45-degree mounting angles , making it easy to align the cam with the grip's texture—so you can position the half-waffle pattern exactly where you want it. Plus, the throttle tube is crafted from an ultra-smooth, low-friction material for lightning-fast response. signals.title: Schuberth expands its helmet range: introducing the E2 ANC and C5 GT
signals.summary: The German company Schuberth , which specialises in the design and manufacture of helmets for motorcyclists and professionals, is expanding its touring and adventure range by introducing three new models in its range. The new E2 ANC introduces active noise cancellation to the brand’s adventure range for the first time. The system, developed in collaboration with Cardo, counteracts persistent wind and road noise whilst ensuring that important sounds such as traffic, the engine and sirens remain audible. The same technology is featured on the C5 ANC , now also available with new graphics, which complement the solid-colour options already in the range. The C5 GT also makes its debut , an evolution of the C5 modular helmet. Among the updates, a visor with a high-contrast coating stands out – derived from the technologies used in Schuberth’s Formula 1 helmets – combined with a Harman Kardon audio system optimised for the SC2 intercom. The features of the original platform remain unchanged, including ECE 22.06 type-approval and dual P/J type-approval. signals.title: Benelli Tornado Naked Twin 700, redefining the naked motorcycle
signals.summary: Benelli presents the Tornado Naked Twin 700 at EICMA, the new flagship of its range. Power comes from the 698 cc parallel-twin engine with a 180-degree crankpin offset, already appreciated on the TRK 702 , which here delivers 73.4 hp (54 kW) and 67 Nm of torque. The gearbox is complemented by a bidirectional quickshifter and an assist-and-slipper clutch. An A2-compliant 35 kW version (approximately 48 hp) will also be available for novice riders. In terms of styling, the muscular 15.5-litre fuel tank is paired with a short, compact tail. However, it is the twin-projector headlight and T-shaped daytime running lights that give the bike its distinctive character. The front indicators are integrated into the handguards, while the rear indicators also serve as brake and tail lights, keeping the rear end clean and uncluttered. Equipment includes a 5-inch TFT display with Bluetooth and Wi-Fi connectivity, a USB-C port, map-based or turn-by-turn navigation, call and music management, cruise control, switchable traction control and ABS, heated seat and grips, three riding modes, and tyre pressure sensors. The bike weighs 195 kg in running order and features a seat height of 805 mm. The Tornado Naked Twin 700 will be available through the Benelli dealer network in the second half of 2027. signals.title: Kymco X-Town S 350: comfort and sporty style for everyday commuting
signals.summary: At EICMA 2026, Kymco introduces the X-Town S 350 , a GT scooter designed to blend comfort and practicality with a sporty aesthetic. Its design stands out through sharp lines and sculpted surfaces, featuring an X-shaped light signature across both the front and rear full-LED lighting units. The model shares its technical foundation with the Downtown GT, aiming to strike a balance between daily urban mobility and longer-distance travel. It is powered by a 321cc, four-stroke , liquid-cooled, single-cylinder engine with four valves and electronic fuel injection, producing 27.9 hp at 7,000 rpm and a peak torque of 30.8 Nm at 5,500 rpm. The engine complies with Euro 5+ standards and is paired with a chassis featuring a telescopic front fork and dual rear shock absorbers, the latter offering five-position preload adjustment. The scooter rides on a 15-inch front wheel and a 14-inch rear wheel, fitted with 120/70 and 140/70 tires, respectively. The braking system consists of a 260 mm front disc and a 240 mm rear disc, equipped with ABS. A traction control system (TCS)—which can be switched off—provides an extra layer of safety on low-grip surfaces. With a curb weight of 187 kg, a wheelbase of 1,500 mm, and a seat height of 800 mm, the X-Town S 350 is well-suited for both extended commutes and weekend getaways, further supported by a 13-liter fuel tank. The equipment includes a 7-inch color TFT display, keyless ignition, and a manually adjustable windshield. There are two storage compartments in the inner leg shield, one of which features a USB port for charging a smartphone. A second socket is located in the 41.9-liter under-seat storage compartment, which is spacious enough to hold one full-face helmet and one open-face (jet) helmet. signals.title: Honda CBR1000RR-R Fireblade 2027: faster in corners and fuller mid-range torque
signals.summary: Honda has unveiled the 2027 CBR1000RR-R Fireblade. The engineers worked on every aspect of the motorcycle to create a production superbike that is faster on the track without compromising its usability on the road. First, they defined the race bike requirements with the WorldSBK team, and then developed the road version. Key objectives included more effective corner entry, higher cornering speed, better exit acceleration, and reduced weight. The 2027 Fireblade weighs 199 kg with a full tank and features increased front-end weight bias (53.3% compared to the previous 52.8%). The new aluminum frame features a revised rigidity balance (lateral rigidity reduced by 20%). It is paired with a shorter aluminum swingarm to improve traction. Additionally, the lower mount of the Showa BFRC-Lite rear shock absorber has been moved from the frame to the rear of the engine. Up front, it features a fully adjustable 43 mm Showa BPF inverted fork; both the shock and fork are fully adjustable. The aerodynamic package is brand new; the fairing has been redesigned using MotoGP experience: it drops the winglets while maintaining the same downforce, thanks in part to the use of novel sidepods in the lower section. The power of the short-stroke inline four-cylinder engine is confirmed at 217 hp (160 kW). Honda worked on power delivery to improve mid-range pull: the peak torque of 114 Nm is reached at 10,500 rpm—1,500 rpm earlier than the 2024 model—partially thanks to variable intake funnels. The electronics revolve around a 6-axis IMU. There are 3 default, highly customizable Riding Modes , HSTC traction control adjustable across 9 levels, and Launch Control is included. The 2027 Honda CBR1000RR-R Fireblade will be available in the Pearl Deep Mud Gray color scheme. Alongside the standard version are the SP and HRC Works Edition models. The SP stands out for its Öhlins S-EC 3.0 semi-active suspension and even higher-performing Brembo Hypure brakes. The 2027 Fireblade HRC Works Edition is built for the track: the steering head angle and swingarm pivot position are adjustable, it features mechanical Öhlins suspension (NPX28-30 fork and TTX36 shock), and braking is handled by Brembo Hypure Sports calipers. It will be available in the Ignition Red color scheme, complete with a matching single-seat cover. signals.title: Regina Chain: HPE technology meets the exclusivity of the Aprilia X 250TH
signals.summary: The Lombardy-based company , which has been manufacturing motorcycle drive chains for over a century, is presenting its range at EICMA , along with a number of applications developed in collaboration with racing teams. The star of the Regina Chain stand (Hall 5 – Stand M71) will be HPE (High Performance Endurance) technology, which eliminates the need for periodic lubrication through design solutions aimed at minimising friction and wear. Among the applications on display is the chain created for the exclusive Aprilia X 250TH, of which only 30 units were produced and which was developed in collaboration with Aprilia Racing. The component features a ta-C carbon coating on the bushings and rollers, optimised seals and bevelled plates. With a pitch of 520 and a weight of less than 1.9 kg, it is designed exclusively for this model and will not be sold separately. Alongside the HPE, Regina Chain will present a complete range of chains for various motorcycling segments, from road and sports applications through to adventure, enduro and motocross. Also on display will be Josep Garcia’s KTM 250 EXC-F, on which the Spaniard won the 2026 Enduro World Championship. signals.summary: Moto Morini previews the Camel at EICMA 2026 , a mid-displacement adventure bike featuring a 21-inch front wheel that looks firmly beyond the asphalt. The name is particularly evocative, bringing back memories of the 1980s twin-cylinder that pushed all the way to the Paris-Dakar. A true statement of intent. The new Camel wears a sand-colored livery combined with black bodywork, featuring an LED headlight, a high windscreen, a two-level seat, an exposed subframe, and a luggage rack: it has the look of a rally raid motorcycle. The engine is a 670 cc parallel twin delivering 81.5 hp at 10,000 rpm and 70 Nm at 7,000 rpm, Euro5+ certified, and also available in a depowered version for riders with an A2 license. Equipment includes ride-by-wire throttle, multiple riding modes, multi-level adjustable traction control, and switchable ABS for off-road use, alongside Bluetooth and navigation via the Moto Morini app. The chromium-molybdenum steel trellis frame is paired with a single-piece aluminum swingarm, ground clearance is 280 mm, the seat height is 850 mm, and the declared dry weight is 200 kg. The chassis relies on adjustable suspension for preload, rebound, and compression, with 250 mm of travel on both axles. Up front is an upside-down fork with 48 mm stanchions, while at the rear there is a progressive pro-link monoshock. The 21-inch front and 18-inch rear spoked wheels are fitted with tubeless tires. signals.title: EICMA, THE 83RD EDITION OFFICIALLY OPENS: THE BIGGEST EVER
signals.summary: The International Two-Wheeler Exhibition opens at Fiera Milano Rho in the presence of Deputy Prime Minister Matteo Salvini: ten halls, 765 exhibitors and 2,142 brands from 52 countries. Today and tomorrow are dedicated to business, with thousands of journalists and tens of thousands of trade visitors from around the world expected to attend. Open to the public from 5 to 8 November. Milan, 3 November 2026 – The 83rd edition of EICMA – the International Two-Wheeler Exhibition – officially opened today at Fiera Milano Rho, in the presence of Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Infrastructure and Transport Matteo Salvini. The event will run until Sunday, 8 November. With 765 exhibitors, 2,142 brands from 52 countries and a total exhibition area of 300,000 square metres , including indoor and outdoor spaces, EICMA has reached a new milestone in its history, which began in 1914 . For the first time since moving to the Rho exhibition district, the event occupies ten halls , one more than in 2025, reaching its largest-ever footprint at the Milan exhibition venue. The opening ceremony was attended, alongside Minister Salvini, by Paolo Magri , CEO of EICMA S.p.A.; Pietro Meda , Chairman of EICMA S.p.A.; Mariano Roman , Chairman of Confindustria ANCMA; Giovanni Bozzetti , Chairman of Fondazione Fiera Milano; Matteo Zoppas , President of ICE – Italian Trade Agency; Giuseppe Sala , Mayor of Milan; and Attilio Fontana , President of the Lombardy Region. The opening of the event centres on the two B2B days, today and tomorrow, Wednesday 4 November , dedicated to the press and industry professionals. Thousands of journalists and tens of thousands of trade visitors from across the world are expected in the exhibition halls for an event bringing together product presentations, international premieres, business meetings, conferences and networking opportunities. Manufacturers, suppliers, importers and distributors are gathering in Milan to discover the latest developments, establish business agreements and expand their networks, while the media bring new products and trends to the attention of a global audience. «Since 2021, we have doubled the number of halls, from five to ten. This growth reflects the decision of companies to continue investing in EICMA and in the value of face-to-face meetings – says Paolo Magri, CEO of EICMA –. The two B2B days are at the heart of this role: here, companies' work meets a global audience, generating business contacts, communication opportunities and access to new markets». EICMA's international appeal is further confirmed by the fact that 74% of the brands come from abroad , while 30% of direct exhibitors are taking part for the first time or returning to the event . These figures demonstrate not only the exhibition's growth in size, but also the renewal of its offering and the broad representation of the two-wheeler industry and its related supply chain. «An entire industry comes together around EICMA: companies prepare their latest innovations, professionals travel across the world to meet, and enthusiasts plan their visits – says Pietro Meda, Chairman of EICMA –. This creates opportunities and jobs even beyond the exhibition halls, involving Milan and the Lombardy Region. Our responsibility is to turn this attention into value for the entire supply chain, from major manufacturers to start-ups». From Thursday 5 to Sunday 8 November , EICMA will open its doors to the general public, offering visitors the opportunity to discover the latest products from manufacturers, new technologies and accessories, alongside a programme of competitions, shows, test rides and special features. From the outdoor MotoLive arena to experiences dedicated to urban mobility, and the history of motorcycle racing explored through the exhibition dedicated to MotoGP , the event will offer a wide range of attractions, while keeping products and the meeting between businesses and enthusiasts at its heart. “Always the first time. Every year, a new discovery” is the message accompanying this year's edition. It captures EICMA's ability to mark a before and an after for the motorcycle industry and the entire supply chain : expectations turn into tangible innovations, technologies are showcased to the public, and the trends shaping the next season begin to take form. An event that remains a key fixture in the industry's calendar, renewing the excitement of discovery every year. EICMA is open to the public from 5 to 8 November, from 9:30 am to 6:30 pm. signals.title: Alasan Veda Pratama Bawa Walang Goreng di Parc Ferme Moto3 Malaysia
signals.summary: Alasan Veda Pratama Bawa Walang Goreng di Parc Ferme Moto3 Malaysia JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Pebalap Indonesia, Veda Ega Pratama, membawa belalang goreng saat meraih podium kedua Moto3 Malaysia 2026 di Sirkuit Sepang, Minggu (1/11/2026). Kejadian itu terlihat usai Veda memberhentikan motor di parc ferme . Kudapan itu juga sempat ditawarkan kepada pemenang balapan, Maximo Quiles, yang membela CFMOTO Gaviota Aspar Team. Veda terlihat menyodorkan kotak berisi belalang goreng kepada Quiles. Namun, pebalap asal Spanyol itu justru tampak terkejut ketika melihat isinya. Baca juga: Diskon Pajak Kendaraan di Banten Diperpanjang, Ini Batas Waktunya Saat ditawari, Quiles menolak. Veda kemudian mencicipi belalang goreng tersebut, sementara Quiles memperhatikan dengan ekspresi heran. "Dia bilang, 'Oh, tidak, wah gila kamu'," kata Veda menirukan Quiles saat wawancara virtual, Kamis (5/11/2026). MOHD RASFAN Pebalap Honda Team Asia asal Indonesia yang menempati posisi kedua, Veda Ega Pratama, merayakan kemenangan di podium selama upacara penyerahan hadiah balapan kelas Moto3 dalam ajang MotoGP Grand Prix Malaysia di Sirkuit Internasional Sepang, Sepang, pada 1 November 2026. (Foto oleh MOHD RASFAN / AFP) Veda mengatakan dia sempat bercerita kepada kru bahwa daerah asalnya memiliki makanan yang terbilang unik. Sehingga dia ingin memperkenalkan belalang goreng kepada kru Honda Team Asia Moto3 . Saat dia cerita, manajer tim, Hiroshi Aoyama, mengatakan sudah pernah mencicipi makanan serupa di Jepang. Tapi anggota tim lain jadi penasaran dan ingin mencoba belalang goreng. Baca juga: Ini Modal Veda Pratama Balapan Moto3 Qatar di Sirkuit Lusail "Dari awal tahun saya cerita ke tim di daerah saya ada makanan unik dari Gunungkidul. Kalau Aoyama, saya ceritain, dia sudah pernah coba di Jepang. Di Jepang juga ada. Tim lain juga pengen coba," katanya. Rencana itu sempat tertunda ketika MotoGP Indonesia digelar di Sirkuit Mandalika. Veda mengaku lupa membawa belalang goreng saat itu. "Nah di Mandalika kemarin belum kesampaian, kelupaan bawa, dan baru di Sepang, Malaysia. Karena saya bawa, mereka coba di hari Sabtu," ujarnya. "Pada hari Minggu, saya tidak menyuruh mereka, dan cuma saya memang menyimpan makanannya di tempat saya. Dan waktu dapat podium, mereka bawa," kata Veda. Veda menjelaskan bahwa kegemarannya menyantap "walang" goreng memang karena suka. Dia tidak terlalu mementingkan kandungannya termasuk soal protein. Baca juga: Waspada, Oli Bekas Dikemas Seperti Baru dan Dijual ke Bengkel "Terus kalau walang goreng (mengandung) protein, saya kurang tahu itu. Cuma saya suka aja makan walang goreng," kata veda. "Jadi bukan karena walang goreng proteinnya tinggi saya jadi suka makan, bukan. Karena itu makanan kesukaan saya aja," ujarnya. Dukung KOMPAS.com untuk terus memberikan fakta jernih dari lapangan. signals.title: Sesi Latihan Dimulai Hari Ini, Simak Jadwal MotoGP Qatar 2026
signals.summary: Sesi Latihan Dimulai Hari Ini, Simak Jadwal MotoGP Qatar 2026 JAKARTA, KOMPAS.com - Persaingan MotoGP 2026 semakin ketat setelah Marc Marquez berhasil memenangi balapan utama MotoGP Malaysia 2026 di Sirkuit Internasional Sepang, Minggu (1/11/2026). Pebalap Ducati Lenovo tersebut tampil impresif dengan mengamankan kemenangan ke-80 sepanjang kariernya di kelas premier. Marc berhasil finis di posisi pertama, unggul 4,172 detik atas Pedro Acosta (Red Bull KTM) yang harus puas menempati posisi kedua. Sementara itu, Alex Marquez (Gresini Racing) melengkapi podium di posisi ketiga. Hasil tersebut terasa spesial bagi Alex yang sebelumnya berhasil mengamankan pole position. Baca juga: MotoGP Qatar Terancam Hanya Diikuti 13 Pebalap Kemenangan di Sepang juga semakin memperkuat posisi Marc dalam persaingan menuju gelar juara dunia MotoGP 2026. Pebalap asal Spanyol itu kini mengoleksi 399 poin, unggul 44 poin atas Jorge Martin yang menempati posisi kedua klasemen sementara. Dok. Yamaha Fabio Quartararo saat berlaga pada MotoGP Qatar 2024 Keunggulan tersebut membuat Marc semakin dekat dengan gelar juara dunia. Namun, persaingan masih menyisakan sejumlah seri yang berpotensi menentukan hasil akhir musim ini. Jelang seri berikutnya di Qatar, persaingan MotoGP 2026 mendapat perkembangan baru setelah Yamaha memastikan tidak akan berpartisipasi dalam Grand Prix Qatar. Keputusan tersebut diambil dengan mempertimbangkan situasi keamanan di kawasan Timur Tengah. Yamaha menilai belum ada alasan yang cukup kuat untuk mengubah kebijakan pembatasan perjalanan yang saat ini berlaku di lingkungan perusahaan. Baca juga: Yamaha Mundur dari MotoGP Qatar 2026, Dorna Kecewa Kebijakan tersebut berlaku untuk kedua tim Yamaha, yakni Monster Energy Yamaha MotoGP dan Prima Pramac Yamaha. Dengan demikian, Fabio Quartararo, Alex Rins, dan Jack Miller dipastikan tidak akan turun pada seri yang dijadwalkan berlangsung di Sirkuit Lusail tersebut. Meski Yamaha memutuskan mundur, penyelenggara MotoGP tetap berencana menggelar Grand Prix Qatar pada 6-8 November 2026. Pihak penyelenggara menyatakan telah melakukan evaluasi terhadap situasi keamanan dan berkoordinasi dengan otoritas setempat sebelum memutuskan untuk tetap melanjutkan agenda balapan. Bagi Marc, seri Qatar berpotensi menjadi kesempatan penting untuk semakin mendekatkan diri dengan gelar juara dunia MotoGP 2026. Dengan keunggulan 44 poin atas Jorge Martin, Marc memiliki peluang untuk mengunci gelar sebelum dua seri terakhir musim ini. Namun, kepastian tersebut tetap bergantung pada hasil yang diraih para pesaingnya dalam balapan di Lusail. Dukung KOMPAS.com untuk terus memberikan fakta jernih dari lapangan.
